## Summary

Daemon intake + enrichment. Research facts that shape this: a new POST endpoint is four files (http.rs route+handler, domain module, cli client, cli main); SummarizeJob/EmbedJob carry text inline and lanes are provider-keyed so conversation jobs ride with ZERO lane config; EmbedJob.source stays raw|smart (vector-space axis untouched).
